LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_BuffAlly.label: bestow bear warrior
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_BuffAlly.description: Bestow the power of the bear warrior upon an ally. Stats are enhanced while keeping equipment.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_DebuffEnemy.label: polymorph: sheep
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_DebuffEnemy.description: Polymorphs the target into a sheep. Combat ability is lost and voluntary revert is disabled.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_DarkKnight.label: dark knight transformation
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_DarkKnight.description: Transform into a dark knight. Spawns dedicated plasteel plate armor and longsword. Existing gear moves to inventory. Spawned gear is destroyed on revert.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_MassPolymorph.label: mass polymorph
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_MassPolymorph.descriptio: AoE magic that polymorphs pawns within a 5-tile radius into sheep. 60% chance.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_Beastkin.label: beastkin shift
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_Beastkin.description: Transform into beastkin form. Can perform 2nd-stage transformation to full beast while in this form.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_FullBeast.label: full beast shift
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_FullBeast.description: Transform into full beast form. Only usable while in beastkin form.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_Guardian.label: guardian shift
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_Phantom.label: phantom shift
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_Phantom.description: Transform into phantom form. Semi-transparent head, thin body type.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_RaceLocked.label: race-locked shift
LanguageData.SSFTest_Ability_RaceLocked.description: Human-only enhancement transformation. Non-human races cannot use this.
